# Anipixels

> Anipixels makes royalty-free game asset packs (UI and gameplay sound effects, music jingles, UI kits, icons and VFX sprite sheets). The packs are sold on itch.io; each has a free sampler and a playable browser demo. This site describes each pack and offers three free browser tools built from the free samplers.

All assets are generated procedurally by code written with an AI assistant (Claude). No AI image or audio generators, no recorded samples, no third-party art.
Licence (all packs and samplers): use in any number of commercial and non-commercial projects, modify freely, credit not required; no reselling or redistribution of the files themselves.
Prices are in US dollars as listed on itch.io on 25 October 2026.

## Asset packs

- [Crisp UI](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-ui/): 242 sound effects for game menus, HUDs, rewards and pickups. WAV + OGG. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-ui . Free sampler (20 sounds) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-ui-free
- [Crisp Puzzle](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-puzzle/): 100 sound effects for match-3, falling-block, push-block and casual puzzle games. WAV + OGG. Price $5.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-puzzle . Free sampler (20 sounds) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-puzzle-free
- [Crisp Jingles](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-jingles/): 45 short music stingers: 15 game moments, each in chiptune, cozy and synth-pop styles. WAV + OGG. Price $5.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-jingles . Free sampler (9 jingles) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-jingles-free
- [Crisp Cards](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-cards/): 105 sound effects for card games, deckbuilders and casino tables. WAV + OGG. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cards . Free sampler (20 sounds) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cards-free
- [Crisp Cozy](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-cozy/): 261 soft, cute UI sounds for cozy games: wood taps, kalimba, bubbles, paper. WAV + OGG. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cozy . Free sampler (20 sounds) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cozy-free
- [Crisp Cozy Life](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-cozy-life/): 306 cozy gameplay sounds: farming, cooking, crafting, fishing, animals, footsteps. WAV + OGG. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cozy-life . Free sampler (20 sounds) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cozy-life-free
- [Crisp Juice](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-juice/): 68 sprite-sheet effects for casual and puzzle games: gem bursts, coins, stars, confetti. PNG + Godot 4 scenes. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-juice . Free sampler (8 effects) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-juice-free
- [Crisp Kit](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-kit/): 100 UI pieces x 8 themes, 127 icons, 93 input prompts. PNG + SVG, 9-slice, Godot 4 themes. Price $6.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-kit . Free sampler (57 pieces) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-kit-free
- [Crisp Quest](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-quest/): 135 RPG UI pieces x 6 fantasy themes, 184 icons. PNG + SVG, 9-slice, Godot 4 themes. Price $6.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-quest . Free sampler (52 pieces) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-quest-free
- [Crisp Pixel](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-pixel/): 139 pixel-art RPG UI pieces x 6 themes, 157 icons at 16 x 16. PNG 1x-4x, 9-slice, 2 pixel fonts, Godot 4 themes. Price $6.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-pixel . Free sampler (53 pieces) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-pixel-free
- [Crisp Cute](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-cute/): 130 pastel UI pieces x 6 cozy themes, 138 cozy icons. PNG + SVG, 9-slice, Fredoka font, Godot 4 themes. Price $6.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cute . Free sampler (54 images) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-cute-free
- [Crisp Icons](https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-icons/): 590 game icons: UI, items, actions, economy. White, dark + badge. PNG 32-256 px, SVG, atlases, Godot 4. Price $4.99. Buy: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-icons . Free sampler (42 icons) and browser demo: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-icons-free

## Bundle

- [Crisp Everything Bundle](https://itch.io/s/203391/crisp-everything-bundle): all 12 packs above for $17.99 (the single prices add up to $69.88).

## Free browser tools

- [UI sound board](https://anipixels.github.io/tools/ui-sound-board/): plays the 109 free sampler sounds from the six sound packs, with search, pack filter, volume and copy-file-name.
- [UI kit 9-slice preview](https://anipixels.github.io/tools/ui-kit-preview/): live resize of the Crisp Kit, Crisp Quest, Crisp Pixel and Crisp Cute sampler pieces using their 9-slice borders, on light or dark.
- [VFX sprite sheet player](https://anipixels.github.io/tools/vfx-player/): plays the 8 Crisp Juice sampler sprite sheets on a canvas with speed, loop, blend and background controls.

## Free browser games (on itch.io)

- [Tune Trail](https://anipixels.itch.io/tune-trail): Marble music puzzle: place deflectors so the marble hits the chimes in melody order.
- [Chime Gems](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-gems): Match-3 puzzle.
- [Chime Blocks](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-blocks): Block puzzle on an 8 x 8 board.
- [Chime Sort](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-sort): Ball sort puzzle.
- [Chime Tiles](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-tiles): Triple tile-match puzzle.
- [Chime Drop](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-drop): Drop and merge puzzle.
- [Chime Connect](https://anipixels.itch.io/chime-connect): Pair-link puzzle.
